summary: Coincheck Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements as of June 30, 2026, and related MD&A for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The report also references prior acquisitions of 3iQ and Aplo but does not announce any new special situation. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, with no disclosed transaction, board action, or strategic event. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present, making this a standard financial reporting filing.
